scientific.integrity: The publisher full text was inspected at the experimental lengths, Table 1, Model-M definition and equations, calibration and AICc definition, Table 2, and the results discussion. The model-definition and Table 2 pages were visually inspected. The experimental OAS2 paper was checked for the 35-bp activation scale. A same-titled 2020 thesis was located but its repository full text was inaccessible, so no negative whole-document claim is based on it. Exact arithmetic is reproduced by the bundled checker.
scientific.limitations: The result identifies an exact boundary inconsistency in the published Model-M definition and one-length model-selection calculation. It does not decide the biologically preferred occupancy convention, refit the 70-bp data with n=2, or infer the corrected AICc ranking.

title: The printed OAS2 multi-binding capacity changes at 70 bp, not above 70 bp
